canonical_summary: Eggplant is a plant that grows in Paris market gardens and belongs to the solanaceae family, native to tropical regions of the Old and New Worlds. Sown in January and February on a warm bed, transplanted after emergence to layers with boxes and frames, covered with sashes or bells in May; each plant should have 5-6 fruits.
